verdict.rationale: Jitsu runs a first-party MCP server at use.jitsu.com/mcp. Its docs say an AI agent connected to it can 'run your data pipeline for you': create destinations, wire up streams, inspect Live Events and edit Functions, with OAuth 2.1 browser approval or an API key for headless use. A user can therefore operate the product through natural-language prompts to their agent, though the language understanding comes from the external agent, not from Jitsu itself. Missing for 10: no built-in natural-language interface in the Jitsu UI, no independent or hands-on corroboration that agent-driven operation works as described, and no documentation of how much of the product's surface the MCP tools cover.
